changes: First library release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74 on the Modwerk base: a stereo phaser on the send bus.
Send each track from its SEND page (AMP twice); choose PHASER on SEND FX (DELAY twice on the FX track, FUNC + A).
Eight controls, SPD to WDTH, lockable on the FX track; the sound is Send FX's PHASER, unchanged.
Not yet tested on a unit: this exact build.
